reasoning: The icon depicts a diamond-shaped road sign containing a right-turn arrow, crossed out with a diagonal slash (directions/navigation off). Because the slash bisects the turn arrow inside the tilted square, the clipped segments are hard to parse at small sizes and can easily be confused with an NFC symbol or a tilted phone screen, limiting its usefulness to niche tasks about disabling GPS routing or handling missing routes.

qa.fix: A tilted rounded sign with an arrow-like shape inside, crossed out: most read it as directions/navigation off; the shows (NFC) and means (directions off) contradict each other.
